mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_schedules ( user_id, company_name, position, interview_time, interview_type, meeting_link, round_number, interviewer, notes, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{companyName}, #{position}, #{interviewTime}, #{interviewType}, #{meetingLink}, #{roundNumber}, #{interviewer}, #{notes}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_schedules SET company_name = #{companyName}, position = #{position}, interview_time = #{interviewTime}, interview_type = #{interviewType}, meeting_link = #{meetingLink}, round_number = #{roundNumber}, interviewer = #{interviewer}, notes = #{notes}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId} IS NULL)
UPDATE interview_schedules SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId} IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, company_name as companyName, position, interview_time::timestamp as interviewTime, interview_type as interviewType, meeting_link as meetingLink, round_number as roundNumber, interviewer, notes, status, created_at::timestamp as createdAt, updated_at::timestamp as updatedAt FROM interview_schedules WHERE id = #{id} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId} IS NULL)
